name: Gemini Robotics / Robotics-ER
summary: Two coupled releases: Gemini Robotics-ER, a Gemini variant specialized for embodied reasoning (3D detection, pointing, grasp proposal, trajectory prediction), and Gemini Robotics, a VLA that adds action output on top. The pair demonstrated notably dexterous behaviors such as origami folding, card dealing and snack packing, with a cloud-hosted large model paired to an on-robot fast model to meet latency budgets.
innovation: Separating embodied reasoning into its own callable model rather than baking it into one policy.
Pointing and 3D-aware spatial prediction trained directly into a frontier VLM.
Hybrid cloud/on-device inference split to reconcile model size with control rate.
matters: Signals that frontier general-purpose models, not robotics-specific ones, may become the default robot brain.
limits: Closed weights and restricted partner access; independent evaluation is not possible.
lineage: The RT-2 concept rebuilt on the Gemini family with a dedicated reasoning sibling.
